items.summary: The results table no longer stacks digits on phones. Numeric cells (p50, p95, Max, n) are .num: white-space nowrap and overflow-wrap normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere stays only on the check-name row header. Up to 30rem the n column and the Result column are display:none (so they leave the accessibility tree) and each result is shown once more as a .verdict line under the check name inside the row header (display:none beside the numbers on wide windows, display:block on phones), which leaves name + p50/p95/Max in 320 px and in 200% text on an iPhone 13 (the plain 'drop n' variant still overflowed by 146 px in a11y.spec.ts 'fits a phone with the text at 200%'). The 'Key press / Pointer press handling delay' row names lost their '(information only)' tail (the Result cell says 'For information'), so no word is broken inside a word at 320 px. Caption now says 'n is the number of samples'. Table keeps native table display and semantics (no display override), so no ARIA role patching is needed.
tests_added: e2e/ux-selftest.spec.ts (chromium, webkit, iphone): every visible number cell is set in one line at 320, 360 and 390 px, no sideways scroll, name column >= 64 px, n column hidden; no word of the check names or results is broken inside a word at 320 px; on a phone the result is in the row header and read once (3 cells per row), on 1024 px it is the last column (5 cells, n visible, all numbers one line)

src/selftest/RtSelfTest.dom.test.ts: number cells and the n column carry .num/.n, header classes, 7 rows with 5 cells, row names without '(information only)', the .verdict span equals the Result cell text and class, caption explains n
items.notes: Verified against the old component: e2e/ux-selftest.spec.ts fails 7 of 10 on the HEAD RtSelfTest.svelte (incl. the one-line-numbers test). a11y.spec.ts 'rt-selftest-results: fits a phone with the text at 200%' (iphone) passes. The test measures the lines a cell's text is set in with Range.getClientRects, not the cell height, because a table cell is as tall as the tallest cell of its row (the wrapping check name).

items.summary: Start no longer drops focus: it is aria-disabled="true" (not disabled) while a run goes on, start() ignores presses while running, it is aria-describedby the polite status line, and the key phase still takes focus when it begins; 'Run again' is a plain button again afterwards. The two developer notes in the copied report are now INPUT_LATENCY_NOTE 'For information only: reaction times use the time stamp of the key press or tap itself, so this delay is not part of them.' and a new EVENT_CLOCK_NOTE "This browser's event time stamps use a different clock, so reaction times are timed when the page handles the press, which is less precise." (exported in measure.ts; note text only, no change to values, maths, keys or report_version). The 34-word intro is split into a short sentence, a list of what is measured, and short sentences on the p50/p95 rule and the information-only delays (no sentence over 25 words). 'Press the space bar' is now 'Press the <kbd translate="no">Space bar</kbd> N times'. Copy messages are 'Report copied.' and 'Copying was blocked. The report is selected: copy it yourself.' (report still selected). A banner link 'HumanBench' (translate=no, 44 px high, href = import.meta.env.BASE_URL) leads back to the app. rt-selftest.html noscript is 'This page needs JavaScript. Turn it on to continue.'; <title> and h1 'RT timing self-test' are unchanged (routes.ts and rt-selftest.spec.ts match them).
tests_added: src/selftest/RtSelfTest.dom.test.ts (15 tests, jsdom, fake display): link home under BASE_URL with translate=no; h1 kept and 'Nothing is saved or sent.'; no sentence over 25 words and a list of measures; plain words; Start is a real button described by the status; Start keeps focus, is aria-disabled and not disabled through the run, then the key prompt has focus; extra presses on Start do not start a second run (same number of frame requests); Run again works after results; the key name is 'Space bar' in <kbd translate=no>; report notes in plain words; 'Report copied.'; blocked copy message and selection
src/selftest/measure.test.ts: an epoch-based event time stamp is reported with EVENT_CLOCK_NOTE; both notes have no developer names or 'RT' and no sentence over 25 words

e2e/ux-selftest.spec.ts (chromium, webkit, iphone): Start keeps focus by keyboard (Enter, twice) and then the Space bar prompt is focused; banner link to /humanbench/ works and is >= 44 px; page text has no developer words and no long sentences, kbd translate=no; JSON notes are one of the two plain notes; copy success and blocked messages with the report selected; no-JavaScript text
